about: Exact strings check R5 (scripts/checks.mjs) lets through, each with the reason it is safe. Keep this list as short as possible. Made-up installers need no entry: an id starting FAKE-, an email ending @example.com and a phone with 555-01 in the middle are allowed by the check itself.

allowed.reason: Joe Lull's own work address, shown on About this data and on every Installer view so staff can report a wrong value (specification sections 4.6 and 4.11, Joe's ruling of October 8, 2026). Not an installer's.
